prose:
The visible portion of hnpredictions.com tracks Hacker News predictions against later events, showing an example where a December 2025 forecast of a 2026 stock-market correction is marked as matched by a November 2026 downturn.

Only the site's opening section was readable, so its methodology, scoring rules, sample size and selection criteria could not be evaluated. A single displayed match says nothing about overall hit rate, and self-selected "matched prior predictions" links are the site's own judgment. No archive of all predictions or independent audit was inspected.
highlights: Site matches old predictions to later events
Only the opening example was readable
Scoring methodology and full archive were not reviewed
One displayed match is not an accuracy rate
Matching judgments are the site's own
No prediction was made or endorsed
